briefing: Markets sold off sharply today with NASDAQ down 2.9% and the S&P 500 down 1.8%, putting us in a risk-off regime with no new candidates screened. We're holding all 7 existing positions unchanged and keeping cash on the sidelines rather than forcing a buy into weakness.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' day is when investors broadly sell riskier assets like growth stocks and tech shares, often moving into cash or safer assets instead. On days like this, the best move is usually to avoid chasing new positions and let your existing risk controls (stop-losses and profit targets) do their job.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險規避」(Risk-Off)是指投資者普遍拋售風險較高的資產,例如增長股和科技股,轉而持有現金或更安全的資產。在這種日子,最佳策略通常是避免追入新倉位,讓現有的風控機制(止損和獲利點)自動發揮作用。

market_education.summary_en: Broad-based selling hit technology and growth names hardest today, consistent with a risk-off rotation out of higher-beta assets. NASDAQ's steeper 2.9% decline versus the S&P 500's 1.8% drop suggests investors were specifically de-risking growth and tech exposure rather than the market as a whole. No specific news catalysts are available in today's data feed to attribute the move to a single headline.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市普遍下跌,科技股及增長股跌幅最大,反映資金正從高風險資產撤離。納指下跌2.9%,跌幅明顯大於標普500的1.8%,顯示投資者主要減持科技及增長股倉位,而非全面拋售。今日數據源未提供具體新聞標題可供引用解釋此次下跌的具體原因。
